llms.value: GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI, released November 7, 2023), via API
llms.quote: We used GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI), released on November 7, 2023, as an LLM

prompting.value: Zero-shot with PICO inclusion/exclusion criteria in prompt (original prompt); post hoc: modified prompt loosening criteria; majority vote over 3 iterations; chain-of-thought
prompting.quote: the LLM, without prior knowledge, decided to include or exclude each citation based on the inclusion and exclusion criteria in terms of the PICO sheet of the selected CQ

dataset.value: Title/abstract screening data for 5 clinical questions (CQs) of the Japanese Clinical Practice Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock (J-SSCG 2024)
dataset.quote: data from the title and abstract screening process for 5 CQs in the J-SSCG 2024

n_records.quote: 8 of 5634 publications in CQ 1, 4 of 3418 in CQ 2, 4 of 1038 in CQ 3, 17 of 4326 in CQ 4

sensitivity.value: 0.91 (95% CI 0.77-0.97), pooled over 5 CQs, modified prompt + majority vote, reference = full-text inclusion
sensitivity.quote: Using the modified prompt and a majority vote, the aggregate sensitivity and specificity values among the 5 CQs were 0.91 (95% CI, 0.77-0.97) and 0.98

specificity.value: 0.98 (95% CI 0.96-0.99), pooled over 5 CQs, modified prompt + majority vote, reference = full-text inclusion
specificity.quote: the aggregate sensitivity and specificity values among the 5 CQs were 0.91 (95% CI, 0.77-0.97) and 0.98 (95% CI, 0.96-0.99)

workload.value: Reduction in records for humans NR; screening time per 100 studies 1.3 min (LLM) vs 17.2 min (conventional), mean difference -15.25 min (>10-fold reduction)
workload.quote: LLM-assisted screening was associated with reduced time for processing 100 studies (1.3 minutes vs 17.2 minutes for conventional screening methods

notes: Total records summed from per-CQ counts (5634+3418+1038+4326+2253). Primary analysis (original prompt, protocol-registered): pooled sensitivity 0.75 (95% CI 0.43-0.92), specificity 0.99 (0.99-0.99); per-CQ sensitivity 0.25-1.00. Secondary analysis (reference = title/abstract inclusion): sensitivity 0.49 (0.35-0.63), specificity 1.00 (0.99-1.00). Post hoc modified prompt: 0.89 (0.74-0.95) / 0.98 (0.97-0.99). Original prompt + majority vote: 0.75 / 0.99. Original prompt + chain-of-thought: 0.71 / 0.99. Modified prompt + chain-of-thought: 0.87 / 0.98. Best configuration (modified prompt + majority vote) is post hoc, not prespecified. Human comparator: 2 independent clinical-expert reviewers; meta-analysis results for CQ 4 comparable between methods.
